t: Long arm riveter ideal for engineers, mechanics and maintenance technicians. Features soft grip handle for improved comfort when working and high performance 3-jaw gripping system with built-in mandrel collector, to capture the stems released from the riveter. Long arms and built-in power reduction mechanism reduces the amount of effort required to install rivets compared to traditional riveting tools. Suitable for use with heating, ventilation, air conditioning units, sheet metal and gutters. Supplied with interchangeable heads and spanner.
